insights: 4,648 streamers share 59,382 mutual follows — density 0.0055: only ~0.55% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 2.886 hops apart (diameter ≥ 9).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 15% of all tie endpoints (max degree 1022 vs median 12).
Partner assortativity = -0.217: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.189: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 11 communities (modularity 0.40); the largest, C1, holds 31% of streamers.
C4 is the most 'professional' community: 13% Partners vs 8% overall.
C3 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (44% vs 29% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
80 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
85 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
